scientific_question: Can an equal-coordinate non-orthogonal symmetric output shear recover c_proj singular-value-changing motion that the accepted hidden-only Givens plus bounded temporal-error chart misses, without a learned basis, persistent adapter, or inference transform?

accepted_cfc_only_parent.fact: c_fc-only is slightly better than repaired attention at every fixed checkpoint, so c_fc is frozen and c_proj is the only unresolved MLP component.

cproj_only_attribution.fact: c_proj-only matches the rejected joint result within 0.0041 CE at terminal.

symmetric_capacity_oracle.fact: The useful layer-0 general output action was almost entirely symmetric; skew-only action was null. The one-sided layer-0 endpoint family itself remains closed because it recovered only 62-63% of dense layer-0 task gain.

bounded_temporal_control.fact: Decay-0.5 temporal feedback prevents the late accumulation failure of decay 1.0 at 350M and is retained unchanged.

cross_scale_transfer.fact: The bounded temporal chart transfers across width but still leaves a measurable attention-relative gap, motivating a structural direction change rather than another decay or capacity sweep.

operator.symmetric_selector: For output-side source columns x_i,x_j and remaining residual columns r_i,r_j, rank undirected edges by (<x_i,r_j>+<x_j,r_i>)^2/(||x_i||^2+||x_j||^2), then compile 32 edge-disjoint perfect matchings from the top 64 neighbors with the existing deterministic native edge-coloring path.
operator.coordinate_fit: For every selected pair use s=(<x_j,r_i>+<x_i,r_j>)/(||x_i||^2+||x_j||^2), recursively refitting the remaining residual after each stage.
operator.fold: Apply exp([[0,s],[s,0]]) to each disjoint pair and fold the result directly into the materialized c_proj weight.

condition_bound.method: project stage coordinates against the sufficient bound exp(2*sum_stage max_pair_abs_s)<=1.1 while fitting

operator.connectivity: deterministic, optimizer-step-local, task-selected, and ephemeral; no basis or coordinate tensor is learned or used in the forward path

performance_gate.protocol: Foreground exact-scientific-config run with one warmup plus eight timed real training updates; direct polling and no watchdog because the gate must finish within five minutes.
performance_gate.fail_action: If MFU is below 20%, do not launch. Optimize the exact same operator without changing stages, thresholds, data, or schedule, then repeat the foreground gate.

scientific_run.curve_requirement: No fixed checkpoint may be worse than the rejected joint full-MLP control by more than 0.005 CE; report every exact difference regardless of pass/fail.
scientific_run.pass_action: If terminal CE is <=3.635838041305542, the full curve satisfies the requirement, and all condition/finite gates hold, accept the symmetric c_proj chart as a near-parent full-MLP replacement and quantify fixed-model token-compute plus execution overhead.
scientific_run.secondary_only_action: If primary fails but terminal CE is <=3.6478, classify as partial direction recovery only; do not promote or tune until fixed-curve diagnostics identify the miss.
scientific_run.fail_action: If terminal CE exceeds 3.6478 or the curve/stability gate fails, reject the sparse symmetric output chart and do not tune its stage count, neighbors, or condition bound.

monitoring.callback_action_prompt: verify live or terminal state and exact artifacts against the active project note; inspect fixed loss, symmetric-shear condition diagnostics, GPU health, and provenance; update durable state; then continue the causal c_proj plan autonomously
